body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2006 CES') -- <Visual News>
Jasco has introduced its new GE VoIP multimedia keyboard at CES 2006.

This model is an Innovation Design and Engineering Award honoree. It has easy accessible multimedia ports on the left side of the keyboard for VoIP accessories and it also features 17 multimedia hotkeys that control multimedia applications.
